en: With a strange whirring, a Tetramystica glides across the floor.{w}{p}A Tetramystica specialized for guard duty -- a "Guard Mystica," you might call it.{w}{p}Here and there the students have scrawled on it: "Idiot," "Moron," even doodled nose hairs.{w}Even so, its function of guarding the Academy is still fully intact.{w}{p}So it is only natural that, on spotting you outsiders who don't belong to the Academy, it moves to eliminate you.{w}

You have run into a foe you never expected.{w}A vast form, its whole body blazing with light.{w}{p}Without a sound, the very air shudders and trembles.{w}With the word "alien" lodged in your hearts, you stand exposed to its savage power.{w}
Suddenly, a gigantic beast appears before you.{w}Half tiger and half horse, it flails its arms and thrashes its whole body wildly.{w}{p}And now its fury turns on you as well.{w}

Darkness within darkness.{w}Welling up from the abode of the Nether King, it fills the air around it with an incomprehensible tongue.{w}{p}What it is saying: unknown.{w}What it is even trying to do: unknown.{w}{p}But one thing is clear:
it means to destroy you.{w}

A giant leaps out in front of you.{w}It seems to be distracted by something else.{w}{p}It doesn't appear able to tell whether you are enemies or mere visitors.{w}{p}No -- for just a moment it seemed to give it some thought, but
'Eh, I'll just punch them for now and...'{w}seems to be the conclusion it reached.{w}
You succeeded in driving off the fearsome enemy.

You sense a great presence and stop in your tracks.{w}{p}In an instant the presence blankets the world, bearing down on you with overwhelming force.{w}{p}This is the shadow of one who lies "outside" the world.{w}A being unlike you.{w}{p}Beware!
You must never encounter it!{w}{p}This is a warning.{w}
Hide, lest your souls be blown away.
You held your breath and waited for the calamity to pass.{w}{p}"It" vanished in an instant, just as it had appeared.{w}

You feel a great temptation and falter.{w}{p}In an instant the temptation blankets your reason, bearing down on you with overwhelming allure.{w}{p}This is the costume change of one who lies "outside" common sense.{w}A being unlike you.{w}{p}Beware!
You must never awaken to it!{w}{p}This is a warning.{w}
Obey, lest your reason be blown away.

The giant shadow that appeared before you looked somehow familiar.{w}{p}It walked away without a word.{w}{p}Was it just your imagination?

The Stairway of Light stretches up toward the Palace of the Sun.{w}But you can't touch it!{w}{p}It seems that by entering the Palace of the Sun some other way, you lost the right to climb the Stairway of Light.{w}
The Stairway of Light stretches up toward the Palace of the Sun.{w}But you can't touch it.{w}
The Stairway of Light stretches up toward the Palace of the Sun.{w}
Go to the Palace of the Sun?
"What, you haven't done it yet!{w}Come on, let's hurry up and bring out that stairway!"{w}
"Looks like you're all set!{w}Look, Natori and Mayleen came out for us too!"{w}
"You got all three Phantom Stones! That's amazing!"{w}
"My, you people are quite capable.{w}You rise ever higher in my esteem!"{w}
"...Save the celebrating for when the Stairway of Light appears."{w}
"Will it really show up, even in conditions like these?"{w}
"I don't believe we need concern ourselves with the weather or the time of day."{w}
"They say Rafa climbed these very stairs to reach the Palace of the Sun, don't they?"{w}
"There was no sun back then, so it can't have been sunny or daytime either.{w}The conditions are the same, you see."{w}
As if in answer to the two of them, light flooded the surroundings!{w}

"Right, from here on out we're in the realm of myth.{w}Anything could happen.
Don't you lot go losing your nerve on me!!"{w}
"Lord Balgert, the three Phantom Stones have begun to glow!"{w}

"Yeaaaaahhh!!"{w}{p}"You lot...
thanks for letting me do my duty as king."{w}{p}"These folks here are the finest Algrantz has to offer."{w}{p}"We'll bring the sun back, no question, so just sit tight and wait for us!"{w}
"All right, you lot!{w}We're storming the Palace of the Sun!!"{w}
With a war cry, Balgert charged toward the stairs.{w}But...{w}
Balgert's foot passed right through the Stairway of Light.{w}
Mayleen reached out to touch the stairs as well, only for her fingertips to slip right through too.{w}
"Everyone, over here, please.{w}...Now, give me a paw."{w}
At Mayleen's urging, you tried touching the stairs.{w}...It seems that you, at least, can touch them.{w}
"I see. It seems the stairs choose who may use them."{w}
"No way... You've gotta be kidding me!?"{w}
Balgert stood before the stairs once more and tried to set a foot on them.{w}
But his foot could not find purchase on the step.{w}
"I'm the king of Algrantz, damn it!{w}All I'm trying to do is take back the Palace of the Sun!{w}And you're telling me I'm STILL not worthy!?"{w}
"Lord Balgert, please calm down!"{w}{p}"Maybe only the ones who searched out the Phantom Stones and made the stairs appear can climb them!"{w}
"True enough. It isn't the sort of place one storms with a whole army."{w}
"So what, you're telling me to dump the fate of the whole land on these guys' shoulders!?"{w}
"A heavy job like that is exactly the kind a king's supposed to steel himself and take on!!{w}Damn it...!!"{w}
Balgert clenched his fist in bitter frustration.{w}Then, as if he had come to a decision, he turned to face you.{w}

"Truth is...{w}I meant to lead the army up there myself, but... well, you can see how that went."{w}{p}"It's hard, putting something this big on the shoulders of plain adventurers, but...{w}would you take back the Palace of the Sun in my place?"{w}{p}"I, Balgert, ask this of you as the favor of a lifetime.{w}Please, I'm counting on you!"{w}
As if beckoning you, the Stairway of Light shone brighter still.{w}
You tried touching the stairs as well.{w}...But you could not touch them.{w}
"Could it be... that you have already been inside the Palace of the Sun?"{w}
"Now that you mention it, I did hear a rumor like that..."{w}

"Most likely, there is only one road to the Palace of the Sun."{w}{p}"Once, this Stairway of Light was the only way to the Palace."{w}{p}"But now that surface technology can reach it as well, to keep interference from the surface to a bare minimum,{w}{p}some power guarding the Palace of the Sun must be blocking the Stairway of Light."{w}{p}"In other words, only they can enter the Palace of the Sun... That's what it comes to, I suppose."{w}
"No way... You've gotta be kidding me!?"{w}
Balgert stood before the stairs once more and tried to set a foot on them.{w}
But his foot could not find purchase on the step.{w}
"I'm the king of Algrantz, damn it!{w}All I'm trying to do is take back the Palace of the Sun!{w}And you're telling me I'm STILL not worthy!?"{w}
"So what, you're telling me to dump the fate of the whole land on these guys' shoulders!?"{w}
"A heavy job like that is exactly the kind a king's supposed to steel himself and take on!!{w}Damn it...!!"{w}
Balgert clenched his fist in bitter frustration.{w}Then, as if he had come to a decision, he turned to face you.{w}

"Truth is...{w}I meant to lead the army up there myself, but... well, you can see how that went."{w}{p}"It's hard, putting something this big on the shoulders of plain adventurers, but...{w}would you take back the Palace of the Sun in my place?"{w}{p}"I, Balgert, ask this of you as the favor of a lifetime.{w}Please, I'm counting on you!"{w}
"The presence of darkness grows thicker still..."{w}{p}"Mayer, can you truly free and save Rafa?"{w}
"Of course. Once all is done, I will take you all to whatever land you desire, as promised."{w}

"......"{w}{p}"Rafa, wait for me...
I won't let you suffer any longer."{w}

"My, how desperate.
It's enough to make me cry... Ahahaha!"{w}
"That Moonlight Spirit seems to have room in her head for nothing but her own goals."{w}

"All the better for us...
Let her dance to our tune while she can."{w}
"Well, I never thought it would come to this!"{w}{p}"It's all because of that swindler, that Zaalhaut or whatever...{w}That wretch...!!"{w}
"She did a great deal for us."{w}
"But your body, Rafa, it keeps getting more and more...!"{w}
"You're so kind, Rafa, that everyone takes advantage and deceives you."{w}{p}"They use you however they please...{w}Poor, poor Rafa."{w}
"It's all right. I'll save you, okay?{w}I'll set you free from all that pain, okay?"{w}
"Shaharon and the others are going to separate you from the True Crystal, Rafa."{w}{p}"Until then, I won't let anyone into this Chamber of the True Sun."{w}
"Yorfa! That's enough!{w}I'm doing this of my own free will!"{w}
"It's all right, Rafa.{w}I'll protect you.{w}I'll save you, I swear."{w}
"...So now... even my words can't reach you...{w}Yorfa..."{w}
"Don't touch me!{w}You're out of your mind right now!"{w}
"Why?{w}Why would you say something like that?"{w}
"Yorfa! Please, go back to who you used to be!"{w}{p}"We watched over the land together in Nertowa, didn't we!"{w}{p}"Be the way you were back then! I'm begging you!!"{w}

"It's all right, we can go back."{w}{p}"Once I set you free, you and I will be just like before.
Like old times... together forever..."{w}{p}"Nothing else matters..."{w}
"Listen, Rafa..."{w}{p}"I won't let you suffer any longer."{w}{p}"If it means losing you..."{w}
"...then let the land be swallowed by darkness."{w}
"Why...{w}Why do you keep getting in my way?"{w}
In the Chamber of the True Sun, at the very heart of the Palace of the Sun, was the Moonlight Spirit, Yorfa.{w}
"Beyond here... is where Rafa is, you know.{w}Yes, my very own Rafa.{w}Mine, and mine alone..."{w}
Yorfa went on, wearing a look of rapture.{w}
"Would you all please step back?{w}I'm begging you, don't get in my way."{w}{p}"I'll ask you once more.{w}Would you please step back, adventurers?"{w}
"...I see. Then it can't be helped."{w}
Little by little, Yorfa began to change.{w}
"Why?{w}Why won't you just leave me be?"{w}
Tears poured endlessly from Yorfa's eyes.{w}
"I just... I just...{w}I just want to save Rafa...{w}That's all, and yet..."{w}
"I just want to save Rafa...{w}That's all, and yet..."{w}

From here, the Stairway of Light must once have stretched all the way up to the Palace of the Sun.{w}{p}But now the place lay desolate, a mere shadow of what it had been, with nothing divine left about it.{w}There was no sign that the Stairway of Light would appear, either.{w}{p}Was something missing?{w}
As you puzzled over it, the rocks around you began to roll in an unnatural way.{w}Grinding and clattering, they gathered into a human shape.{w}

A colossus made of rock appeared before you.{w}Was it the guardian of this place?{w}{p}All around, birds and insects began to gather, as though driven by some will of their own.{w}{p}They must be the protectors of the sacred ruins.{w}You would have to face this trial.{w}
Under your attacks, the colossus began to crumble.{w}The small creatures that had gathered around it went on their way, as though freed from a spell.{w}
A voice came from out of nowhere.{w}

"So this is our first time meeting face to face, huh...
Not that I'll bother telling you my name.{w}I doubt you'll be needing it."{w}
In an instant, a red-haired woman appeared before you.{w}

"Hey...
There's no point in you holding on to that thing, is there?"{w}
Talking in a flat, detached voice, she walked toward you.{w}

"It doesn't look like it's worth a thing...
but you'd be in trouble without it, right?{w}Well, whatever. In that case, why not give it to me?"{w}

This woman looked human, yet she was not.
No trace of life could be felt from her.{w}
"Hmm... So you're dead set on not handing it over.{w}Then I guess there's only one way to do this!"{w}

"Tch...{w}You're better than I thought."{w}{p}"Well, whatever you lot do,
the outcome won't change."{w}

"Ahahaha!
Go on, keep struggling for all you're worth!"{w}

"I am Necrophilis! The next time we meet,
I will be the one to destroy you! Remember that!"{w}

Leaving only her laughter behind,
the woman vanished into the darkness.{w}
From where the voice had come, a spirit with a face like the Grim Reaper's appeared before you.{w}
"A wise choice.{w}And while I am at it, I may as well finish my other business."{w}
The spirit took a step forward.{w}

"I see...
So you would choose an agonizing death..."{w}{p}"If that is what you wish, I shall grant it."{w}

"...Heh heh.{w}Fighting back here has merely
put off your own deaths..."{w}
The spirit vanished, as if melting into the darkness.{w}

"You there...
What do you intend to do with that thing in your hands?"{w}
A voice suddenly rang out from behind you.{w}From where it had come, a demon appeared, wreathed in a hideous aura unlike anything you had ever seen.{w}

"Cast away that useless thing,
turn your backs on what you fear, and flee."{w}{p}"Or... will you struggle, knowing it is futile?{w}If you give up gracefully, I might yet be persuaded to let you go."{w}
"Very good.{w}Tell me, do you understand the worth of the Palace of the Sun?"{w}{p}"...Hm, it hardly matters whether you do.{w}You will die here regardless."{w}
With a fearless smile, the demon took a step toward you.{w}
"Oho... So you had this much power hidden away.{w}...This should keep me entertained for a long while."{w}

"I am Dark Mayer.
Do try to stay alive from here on.{w}I look forward to our next meeting..."{w}

Still wearing that fearless smile, the demon
vanished soundlessly into the darkness.{w}

"It isn't a title I'm especially fond of, though."{w}
"That flowing hair... that pure white skin..."{w}
"Ahahaha!!{w}For a corpse, you look just like you're alive!!"{w}

"I want it... 'that.'{w}I don't need your heart, so just hand your body over to me."{w}{p}"Just like this one here,
I'll love you properly until you've rotted away completely.{w}Hee hee hee!"{w}

"A kind invitation, but I have work to do."{w}{p}"I can't live up to your expectations,
so be good and go home quietly."{w}
"A mere corpse, talking back to me?{w}Fine, I'll reap it for you.{w}That pointless leftover scrap of a personality... like THIS!!"{w}
"My, my. What a wild little thing.{w}You've ruined my favorite tea set."{w}
"Let me see.{w}It'd be a bother if you thrashed around too much...{w}All right, just hold still like that."{w}

"Look at the sky. What a splendid full moon.{w}...Even for one of the Kin of Darkness,
isn't your timing awfully poor? You silly thing."{w}
"Dam... mit...!!{w}Let go!! Let go of me!!"{w}
"Nooope. Why would I ever let go?{w}Such adorable prey..."{w}

"I'll savor you... nice and slow.{w}Our night is only beginning.
There's so much I want to ask you."{w}
"Ha... haha!{w}Y-you think I'll just answer you nicely?{w}You must really take me for a pushover!"{w}
"Oh, that's fine. You needn't force yourself to talk."{w}{p}"I'm a Soul Therapist, after all.{w}I can probe your heart, or else..."{w}
"You're some kind of pervert, aren't you!?"{w}
"Now, now. A lady mustn't use such vulgar words."{w}{p}"More importantly, look.{w}Your very favorite thing... a corpse's fingers.{w}How about it? Are they to your liking?"{w}
"Wait, hold o...! Don't you dare...{w}Let go! Get off me!! You..."{w}

"...If you don't want to die,
you'll answer my questions."{w}

"Hehe, that's a good girl.{w}If you behave, there's no need to be afraid.
I'll pamper you plenty."{w}
"What... are you going to do... to me...?"{w}

"I don't defile them!{w}Even when they rot, even when they turn to sludge,
I treasure them, don't I!"{w}{p}"And besides... I'm, um, proper about it...{w}Okay, sometimes I do... that sort of thing too... but...{w}I'm gentle... and, um..."{w}

"Did the person who owned those remains
wish for you to do that?"{w}

"It seems you don't toy with them out of malice.{w}Very well.
I'll have you undergo Soul Therapy."{w}
"That's right. I'm going to take a little look inside your heart."{w}
"There's no way anyone can see inside a heart.{w}Understanding another person is impossible. Obviously."{w}

"But... if it's for real...{w}You can look at all of it. I'll stay still, okay?"{w}{p}"Don't just take a little peek.
Look at all of my heart..."{w}{p}"I could never fit into this world...{w}Save my heart... please...{w}And if you can't save it... just kill me like this."{w}
"Are you saying you want to die?"{w}

"...Well, all right. Let's begin.{w}Leave everything to me."{w}{p}"...When this hand touches you,
your feelings will slowly come undone.{w}Hehe."{w}

"What's wrong with that? You like it, don't you?{w}...My heart reaches out through my palm,
into your body."{w}{p}"I wonder where your heart is?{w}May I search for it?"{w}
"Slip, slip, slip, slip...{w}I'll search every inch of your body."{w}
"Slip, slip, slip, slip...{w}...Oh, look, I found it.{w}It looks so lonely here. Shall I comfort it?"{w}

"That makes two of us."{w}{p}"...By the way, this has nothing to do
with the therapy, but would you tell me something?"{w}
"Why did you choose a night like this?{w}You might have won in the daytime, you know?{w}Or didn't you know about our nature?"{w}
"...Of course I knew.{w}I've been dealing with corpses for a long time."{w}{p}"Sure, in the daytime I'd have won.{w}I even had White Ash ready."{w}

"Corpses are precious to me.
So I wanted to meet you at your most beautiful,
on the finest stage."{w}{p}"You're at your most beautiful too
on this night, bathed in the full moon's light, right?{w}It's a tiny difference, but I can tell."{w}

"That's all!?{w}Over something that small,
you threw away a fight you could have won easily...?"{w}

"That's right.{w}It's only something that small, but to me,
it's everything."{w}
"...I'm sorry.{w}That was unworthy of a Soul Therapist.{w}Now, let's continue."{w}

Necrophilis's Soul Therapy went on
through the night.{w}

"...The sun is rising.{w}I'm going to rest now, but you ought to
come see me regularly for a while."{w}
"...All my strength's drained out. I can't stand up."{w}
"...Let me stay here. Don't push me away, okay?"{w}

"Oh my, do I have a visitor?{w}I am the Soul Therapist, Emera."{w}{p}"This is my room.

"Well, yeah...{w}Oh, right! Remember the Book of the Next Age we got from Costo?"{w}{p}"Apparently, thanks to that book, for a little while our Bistel and...{w}this town... um... what was it called again?"{w}
"Pleased to meet you, honored instructor from abroad!{w}...Huh? Wait."{w}
"That's weird.{w}That strange book said I'd meet a foreign instructor here..."{w}
"Nice to meet you, I'm Miria. I'm not an instructor, actually. I work the front desk at the Training Hall."{w}
"We've come from the fortress city of Bistel. I'm Soara, of the Magic Bureau."{w}
"Wha...? YOU two are...!?{w}You're not what I imagined... not even close!!"{w}
"I was expecting more of a 'blood pumping, raring to fight!' kind of vibe...{w}I guess training halls really do feel different from country to country."{w}
"By the way, have they already registered at your training hall?"{w}
"Oh, yeah, they should be registered already.{w}Coming all the way from another land just to see them off... your training hall must be something else..."{w}
"H-hey, um!{w}By any chance...{w}are they, like, super-famous heroes or something!?"{w}
Miria started to speak, but swallowed the words with a wry smile.{w}
Seeing that, Soara gave a small nod as well.{w}

For a fleeting moment, fond memories of Finas Rade came back to Miria, Soara and you.{w}{p}The Proclamation of the fortress city, the Queen's Trial, the mysterious boy,{w}Nerineri, the people who tried to save the land in their own way,{w}the deadly battles over the divine relics, and then...{w}{p}Nothing can replace the memories of the adventures you have lived through.{w}But surely you did not come to this land just to reminisce about old times.{w}
"But to us, they're dear friends. Nobody could ever replace them."{w}
"You're right. That was a tactless thing to ask."{w}
"Okay, got it!{w}Our training hall will take full responsibility for your friends. We'll look after them, I promise!"{w}
"Oh, come on. You promised you wouldn't cry."{w}
"Oh, come on. You promised you wouldn't cry.{w}We'd like to give you this, from all of us."{w}
"This is as much as we can do for you."{w}
"Honestly, this is supposed to be their big send-off.{w}Your face is a total mess, you know?"{w}
"We don't think of this as goodbye, you know.{w}It's really hard, seeing all of you leave Bistel.{w}But you know..."{w}
"Our memories... you see.{w}I believe they'll keep us connected, always."{w}{p}"I mean, we got to meet again today like this, didn't we?{w}So we'll see each other again someday, right!"{w}
"I think it's about time...{w}The linked lands are starting to return to the way they were.{w}I wish we could stay, but this is as far as we can see you off."{w}
"We're all rooting for you!{w}Even when we're apart, we'll be friends forever and ever!!"{w}
"...Those are some wonderful friends you've got.{w}I even teared up a little myself.{w}Geez, me, the great Fena, of all people..."{w}{p}"Right, then."{w}

"Let's shake it off and get moving!{w}When the wind blows and the storm has passed, blue skies are always waiting!"{w}{p}"I'll be watching your new adventure with these very eyes, you know!{w}So, once more, welcome aboard!!"{w}

The morning mist slowly lifts, and the towering mountains and the forests that nurture life gently awaken.{w}{p}The Crestard Continent is a land that has prospered under the light pouring down from the Palace of the Sun.{w}{p}Many races live on the continent, among them humans, elves and ogres.{w}{p}Over the long course of history, the elves built an empire in Roscadil, and the ogres raised their stronghold in Ogre Bay.{w}{p}And the humans flourish, with Algrantz at their heart.{w}
The fortress city of Algrantz lies in the north-central part of the continent.{w}Its defining feature is the great wall that rings the entire city.{w}
The outside of the wall bore the painful scars of fierce fighting.{w}It was a stark contrast to the view inside, where not a stone was scratched.{w}
"It looks proud, doesn't it? It's done its job, and done it well. It's not much to look at, but I like it."{w}
In front of you stood a traveling merchant you had never seen before.{w}
"You're adventurers here, right?{w}Want to buy some salves? I'll give you a good price."{w}{p}"...Hm?{w}You haven't registered yet?{w}I see, you're greenhorns... Let's have a look, then..."{w}
The merchant walked a full circle around you, as if sizing you up, then gave a small nod.{w}

"...Well, whatever.{w}You came because you saw the Proclamation too, right? "I'm Hanoi, a traveling merchant.{w}I wander from place to place and make my living by trading.{w}If you like, I can show you around town."{w}{p}"...Why am I being so nice, you ask?{w}Ha ha! Connections are the foundation of business.{w}If we get along, we both come out ahead, right?"{w}
"In times like these, let's help each other out."
"...Hmm."{w}{p}"Well, I guess you've got your own plans. If you're short on time, I'll just give you the quick version."{w}
Hanoi gave you a quick rundown of the people in town.{w}
"Okay, let's start with the Training Hall."{w}
"I think that about covers everything.{w}I can't exactly take you into the castle, so you'll have to go there on your own."{w}{p}"Well then, here's hoping you have a good journey."{w}
"Registering here is an adventurer's first step.{w}If you don't register, you can't use any of the town's facilities for adventurers."{w}
"That's rare, you coming all the way out here. Don't tell me you're here to register?"{w}
"No, no, these folks are the ones registering. Seems they came because they saw the Proclamation."{w}{p}"They were wandering around near the wall, so I'm showing them around town."{w}
"I see. That's good of you to go to the trouble.{w}Nice to meet you. I'm Fena. I'm an instructor here."{w}{p}"If you want to go adventuring, register here first, okay?"{w}
"Could you show them how to register? I don't know how things work inside the Training Hall myself."{w}

"Yeah, sure."{w}{p}"Registering is easy.{w}You just decide on an epithet, a name and a nickname, then write down your race, gender and age."{w}{p}"The classes you can take come in three tiers: basic, intermediate and advanced."{w}{p}"As long as you meet the requirements, you can take any class you like. But the more advanced the class, the harder the requirements are to meet, so keep that in mind."{w}{p}"Once you've built up some experience, I can help you change classes, too."{w}
"I'm gonna whip you into shape, nice and hard, so look forward to it!"{w}

"Just so you don't get the wrong idea, an advanced class doesn't necessarily make you stronger.{w}Strength comes in all kinds of forms, after all."{w}{p}"The best thing you can do is take the class you actually want."{w}
"That's right!{w}Once you've had your tour of the town, come back and see me!"{w}
"All right, next let's head to the tavern."{w}
"Once you've registered at the Training Hall, you can form a party at the tavern.{w}That's where you call in companions you get along with and get ready to set out."{w}

"Everyone's welcome here, so feel free to drop by anytime!"{w}
